label: A pyramid of darkness over Toronto, with Vancouver in light
description: Darkness thick as molasses coming down over Canada in the shape of a pyramid centred on Toronto in Ontario rather than Quebec, spreading outward, described as an Illuminati-style pyramid, while Vancouver stands in light and fights it. He works out the geography on air, correcting himself from Quebec to Ontario, which shows the identification being assembled rather than seen.

label: Corruption and fraud in the Canadian election, to be exposed
description: Corruption in the election and election fraud called out to be exposed four weeks before the April 2025 Canadian vote, with a great depression coming on the area because of how the election is going and because of unrighteous thinking. No fraud was established and the result was not contested on those grounds.
aliases: We call all corruption to be exposed in Canada

label: Two fronts, then three, with Israel as the third
description: Two fronts seen, one in the Middle East and one in Europe, then counted up on air to three areas with Israel's involvement as the third, and Kim Jong-un's face appearing alongside. The number is worked out aloud rather than given.
aliases: Two fronts. One in the Middle East

I'm seeing Kim Jong-un's face again

label: Los Angeles as the focus, with virgins priced higher
description: Los Angeles named as the focus, with Japanese business people seen at the southern tip of Japan alongside it, young virgins priced higher, dark businessmen, drug lords paying parents who have nothing to give their children, politicians involved, and the governor turning a blind eye in the refuge cities, with vengeance so that the rocks will not hide these men.
